exposure: Type of hernia repair (mesh vs. anatomical)
cohort: The study included 140 patients admitted to the hospital for various types of hernias, with 60 of these cases being individuals with incisional hernias.
finding: Incisional hernias accounted for 40% of the total hernia cases studied, were more commonly observed in women than men, and mesh repair was found to be more effective in preventing their recurrence compared to anatomical repair.
mod_finding: An increased number of cesarean sections was attributed as a factor contributing to the weakening of the abdominal wall and the development of incisional hernias.
